properties.name: REALIZES is restricted to Capability, Component and Interface; link_artifact refuses the rest by name, and legacy REALIZES onto a check becomes IMPLEMENTS on open and import
properties.rationale: Anthony's ruling, dec:realizes-is-restricted-to-capability-component-and-interface, after measuring 44 of 45 off-type REALIZES edges wrong. The migration applies the VERIFIES lesson in advance: a tightening must not make an existing design unimportable. Proved against every other committed design on the machine.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: schema/build.yaml REALIZES `to: [Capability, Component, Interface]`; artifact.rs REALIZES_TARGETS + realizes_target_hint and a link_artifact guard before any write; graph.rs migrate_realizes_onto_checks on open; export.rs import converts Artifact REALIZES Verification to IMPLEMENTS (ImportReport.migrated_edges) and names the fitting edge when any other REALIZES target is refused.
